rationale: The workflow already applies the relevant dependency-cache optimization: setup-java@v5 is configured with cache: maven, which caches the local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository) across runs, equivalent to the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern. No matrix strategy exists, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs) is not applicable. CI history shows five successful runs completing consistently in under a minute (~53 seconds), with no evidence of runaway jobs that would justify a custom timeout under P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT; adding a timeout without a demonstrated problem would be speculative rather than evidence-supported. Other patterns (cancel stale runs, change-path filtering, workflow skipping, test selection/prioritization, Bazel tuning) do not fit this single-job Maven CI workflow or lack applicable preconditions. The intended build and test coverage (mvn --batch-mode verify) is already preserved, and no weakening of permissions or new network access is introduced.
